preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the SpaceGrok token (sGrok) to trigger the exploit

exploit_hint: Call the unprotected clearStuckBNB() function to drain all BNB from the contract. The function lacks proper access control (onlyOwner modifier is missing), allowing any user to transfer the contract's BNB balance to themselves. Simply call clearStuckBNB() as any address to steal accumulated BNB fees.
